description: Turns onyo-mode on for every prompt, and adds the onyo-projects rules in a Claude Projects session. A line saying `onyo-mode off` in CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, or the project instructions turns it off for the project, and one in a message turns it off for the session. In a Projects coordinator it also refuses a start_thread_session call whose brief lacks the `onyo-projects: planning thread` or `onyo-projects: unit thread` line.
